name: app-eleven-bottom-navigation-bar-styles-catalog-with-design-tips
title: Eleven Bottom Navigation Bar Styles
whatItIs: A pale grid of eleven mobile bottom navigation bar styles, each in a card with a number and descriptor words: minimal, glassmorphism, floating, neumorphism, pill highlight, centre FAB, gradient bold, outline icons, tab with indicator, curved background and dock style, plus a design tips box.
whatItMeans: A side-by-side catalogue lets designers compare styles quickly, and the descriptors name the mood of each.
techniques: Same five tabs shown in eleven styles
Three descriptor words under each style name
Phone bottom edge as a consistent frame
Violet and pink as the only colours
Tips list in a highlighted box

vocabulary.definition: A tab bar detached from the screen edges.
A raised round action button in the middle of a tab bar.
A rounded translucent bar like an operating-system dock.
